name: hyperframes
description: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
one_liner: A tool that turns HTML layouts, charts, and text into rendered video, letting you generate video content straight from data and code instead of filming anything.
buyer: A news or explainer YouTuber, or an internal comms team, that needs data-driven video content without filming or hiring editors.
business_use_cases: A news YouTuber turns breaking economic data into an animated explainer video within minutes of a report dropping.
A SaaS company auto-generates a monthly 'state of your account' video report for each customer from their usage data.
An internal comms team turns a quarterly OKR dashboard into a short video update for an all-hands meeting instead of a static slide deck.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted 'data-to-video' API that SaaS companies plug into their product to auto-generate customer-facing video reports.

steal_this: Build a tool this weekend that turns a company's analytics dashboard into an auto-generated monthly video report, and pitch it to three SaaS founders.
